intent: Retain sensor size at 0.016 and wheel track at 0.16 to maintain noise robustness and turning stability. Fine-tune sensor y-positions by shifting them forward by +0.005 from the previous iteration (y = 0.055, 0.035, 0.015, 0.035, 0.055) to improve early line detection and control anticipation. Expect this incremental forward shift to reduce line loss events and steering oscillations, improving progress and completion on both oval and s-bend tracks, supporting better generalization.
rationale: Telemetry and integrator feedback show persistent line loss events and steering oscillations despite previous geometry changes. Increasing sensor size and wheel track improved noise robustness and turning stability, but line loss still occurs once per run. A smaller forward shift of +0.005 in sensor y-positions is a reasonable fine-tuning step to detect the line earlier and enhance control anticipation without destabilizing sensor weighting. This should reduce line loss events and improve control smoothness, as supported by telemetry evidence.
